general.descriptionTextModule: Convert JPG and PNG images to WebP.

settings.saveError: The settings could not be saved:

overview.title: Modulwerk WebP converter
overview.engineNone: none – this server cannot write WebP (GD with WebP or Imagick required)
overview.progressDone: Done. Please clear the cache now so the storefront shows the WebP images.
overview.hintCache: The storefront only shows new WebP images after the cache has been cleared.
overview.confirmClear: Really delete all WebP files? The originals are kept.
overview.clearSuccess: All WebP files have been deleted.
overview.progressDoneAuto: Done. The cache has been cleared automatically, the storefront now shows the WebP images.
overview.progressDoneNothing: Done. No new WebP files were created.
overview.hintCacheAuto: The page cache is cleared automatically after each processing (can be switched off under Settings → Automation). After changing settings, clear the cache yourself.
overview.cacheAutoCleared: The page cache has been cleared automatically.
overview.confirmRebuild: Delete all WebP files and reconvert every image with the current settings? The originals are kept. Until an image is done, the storefront shows the original. The entries in the media folder are recreated.
overview.rebuildStarted: All WebP files have been discarded, conversion is running.
